_comment: Golden intent-classification set (item 21). Each entry is a message + the intent the classifier MUST return. Curated to be unambiguous — phrasings whose intent is genuinely model-dependent (mixed-language, contextless follow-ups) are intentionally excluded so a dip in accuracy means a real regression, not dataset noise. Run the gate with: uv run pytest tests/evals -m integration
